name: Applied Fluid Mechanics
description: Basic equations: Eulerian and Lagrangian descriptions, flow visualization, stress tensor, conservation laws, newtonian fluids, body forces. Ideal fluid flow: governing equations, circulation, vorticity, vortex structures, potential flow. Bernoulli and Laplace equations. Thin aerofoil theory: lifting surfaces, lift and drag, Kutta-Joukowski theorem, Kutta condition, slender-body approximation. Viscous flow: D'Alembert’s paradox, form drag, laminar boundary layers, drag crisis, Navier-Stokes equations, boundary conditions. Turbulence: Reynolds stress, turbulent boundary layers, roughness effects, RANS equations, turbulence modeling. Water wave mechanics: nonlinear and linear wave theories, wave forces, dispersion relation, diffraction, and radiation forces. Tutorial activities: vector calculus applications, vortex structures, potential flows, boundary layers, wave forces on submerged bodies, lifting surface problems, and dispersion relations.
